senses.gloss:
(ऌ उ) ऌरधु r. 1st cl. (राध्यति)
1 To finish, to complete, to accomplish.
2 To hurt, to injure or kill.
3 To be right or correct.
4 To cook or mature.

(औ) औराध r. 4th cl. (राध्यति) 5th cl. (राध्नोति)
1 To bring any thing to fulness or completion, to finish, to effect, to accomplish, to complete.
2 To attain completion, to succeed, to be finished or accomplished.
With अप prefixed,
To offend, to be in fault.
With आङ्,
To worship, to propitiate by worship.

m. (-धः)
The month Vaiśākha, (April-May.)
f. (-धा)
1 The asterism, in which the moon is full in the month Vaiśākha; the sixteenth of the Nakṣatras, containing four stars in the shape of a festoon; the stars are supposed to be α ν ι Libra, [] and Scorpionis.
2 A celebrated Gopī, the favourite mistress of KṚṢṆA, during his residence in Vṛndāvana amongst the cow-herds.
3 Lightning.
4 An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart.
5 Emblic myrobalan.
6 A flower, (Clitoria ternata.)
E.
राध to accomplish, aff. अ, टाप् fem. aff., or राधा the asterism, अण् aff. of reference.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hurt, injured.
E.
रध to hurt, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Injurious, hurtful.
E.
रध to hurt, तृच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Completing, accomplishing, succeeding, effecting.
2 Obtaining, acquisition.
3 Pleasure, satisfaction.
4 The means or instrument of accomplishing any thing.
f. (-ना)
Speech, speaking.
E.
राध to accomplish, aff. युच्.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 A plough.
2 Thin rain.
3 Hail.

m. (-न्तः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
राधा, and कान्त beloved.

m. (-यः)
KARṆA.
E.
राधा, and तनय son; see राधासुत.

m. (-थः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
राधा, and नाथ lord.

m. (-त्त्रः)
KARṆA
E.
राधा, and पुत्त्र son: see राधासुत.

m. (-दी)
A name of ARJUNA.
E.
राधा the mistress of KṚṢṆA, and भेदिन् dividing; having prevailed on KṚṢṆA to abandon her.

m. (-भः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
राधा, and वल्लभ beloved.

m. (-धी)
ARJUNA.
E.
राधा the mistress of KṚṢṆA, and वेधिन् who hurts or wounds: see राधाभेदिन्.

m. (-तः)
KARṆA.
E.
राधा the name of the wife of the charioteer of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, by whom the prince, after exposure by his own mother KUNTĪ, was found and fostered, and सुत a son.

m. (-यः)
A name of KARṆA.
E.
राधा a proper name, and ढक् aff.: see राधासुत.
